draft.title: Writing up the project
card: It states the topic, explains why it was chosen and sets out the aim of the research. It tells the reader what the project will do.
It records the research process step by step, such as the methods used and the problems met along the way. It shows how the findings were gathered.
It discusses the findings and uses the evidence gathered to build the argument. The discussion is where the research is analysed.
It sums up what the research found and how it answers the aim. The resource list sets out the sources used, so a reader can trace them.
draft.remember: The write-up moves from aim, to process, to findings, to a conclusion, and lists its sources.

a.q: Ravi wants to explain how he ran his interviews and what went wrong with his first questionnaire. Where does this belong?
a.why: The process log records how the research was carried out, including problems met along the way. The introduction is the tempting choice, but it sets out the topic, the reason for choosing it and the aim, not the steps of the research.
a.clue: Which part records the steps of the research?

b.q: Mei Ling has finished her project on teenage volunteering in Wagga Wagga. She writes a section that sums up her findings and shows how they answer her aim. Which part is this?
b.why: The conclusion sums up what the research found and links it back to the aim. The central material is the tempting choice, because it also deals with findings. It discusses and analyses them in detail with the evidence, rather than summing them up at the end.
b.clue: Which part comes last and looks back at the aim?

problems.detail: The resource list is put inside the Conclusion bullet, so students may think it is part of the conclusion. In the syllabus it is a separate fifth component and should have its own bullet.
The clue says the conclusion is the part that 'comes last', but the resource list comes after it. This adds to the card's blurring of the conclusion and the resource list.

check.summary: Both questions have one clear right answer and the facts match the PIP components. The card merges the resource list into the conclusion bullet, and question b's clue calls the conclusion the last part. Both should be fixed so the resource list reads as its own component.
